items.title: We released skill-metric
items.description: a skills evaluation framework that screens high-quality skill repos across three dimensions. Results can also be found in /skills-metric.

items.title: We open-sourced Skiller
items.description: an automated tool that turns conversation logs or plain-text requirements into standards-compliant skill packages.

Thousands of Agent Skills are scattered across official registries and community repos. A researcher who needs to run a gene ontology enrichment, draft a grant proposal, and plot dose-response curves shouldn't have to dig through 30,000+ entries to find the right three skills. And once found, they shouldn't have to wire them together from scratch.
items.title: The Problem

items.description: Build a single, clone-ready repository of high-quality skills selected and organized for scientific research — spanning bioinformatics, cheminformatics, data analysis, scientific writing, literature search, and beyond.
